criteria.description: Acoustic quality for spoken presentations, echo, reverberation and intelligibility.

notes.text: The subway exit is directly across the street from the entrance.
Voices bounce off the hard walls and the presenter is difficult to understand.
Bolted rows of chairs prevent breakout circles.
Two frequent bus routes stop at the front door.
Soft wall panels make spoken words crisp even at the back.
Tables on wheels let us switch quickly from plenary to small groups.

warning: Scores and weights are user-supplied judgments, not AI measurements. All criteria must use comparable 0–10 higher-is-better anchored scales. Cost must already be translated to a benefit score; raw costs are not accepted. No automatic score inference or normalization. Weighted sums assume additive, compensatory preferences. A complete matrix needs exactly one approved note per option–criterion cell; duplicate evidence is never silently averaged. Held notes survive but do not count. Leave-one-criterion-out comparisons are sensitivity scenarios, not probabilities or proof of a best real-world choice.
